text: E ɓee yi'aali, wonnde Alla no yaññana arsike on mo O muuyani e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, fii ndaarnda- gol ɓe si ɓe yettay Mo maa si ɓe yedday? Himo ɓiɗtinana Mo kadi on Mo O muuyani e maɓɓe, fii anndugol si o muññoto maa o muññoo? Wonii e ɗum, maandeeji wonannde gomɗimɓe neweende e yurmeende Alla nden.
